mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, which reduces discount rates for future corporate cash flows and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances despite a declining FEDFUNDS trend, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate above 5.0% over a one-month window signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which increases the likelihood of central bank rate cuts and triggers a risk-on rebound in equities over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX fails to generate positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly higher than the baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in residential construction starts and consumer spending (RSAFS) signals strong underlying demand momentum, which boosts corporate earnings expectations and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 60-day SPX returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 103.0 over two consecutive months indicates weakening supply-side capacity, which signals potential inflationary pressures and forces the Fed to maintain restrictive policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in less than 60% of triggered instances, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) combined with rising housing starts (HOUST) indicates a strong demand surge that accelerates corporate revenue growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint rise in RSAFS and HOUST fails to generate positive 20-day SPX returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction effect's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in the CPIAUCSL above 240.0 over two consecutive months signals accelerating inflation, which increases the probability of further rate hikes and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in less than 60% of triggered instances, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and a rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a labor market contraction, which increases the likelihood of Fed rate cuts and triggers positive equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of falling PAYEMS and rising UNRATE fails to produce positive 20-day SPX returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP (GDPC1) below 16,500 billion over a four-quarter window indicates a weakening economy, which increases the probability of fiscal or monetary stimulus and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX fails to generate positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
